notes: Read-only Tier-1 capture on a healthy running beacon service. CPU/RSS via tools/sample_resource.sh (--match beacon/main.py, 60 samples, label running_baseline; PID 508, comm python3). SLO via tools/probe_http.sh on the four GET routes (--repeats 40). Identity-mutating POST /vehicle_name and POST /hostname were NOT exercised (would rename the live vehicle and change its mDNS hostname); their journey outcomes remain Unknown. mDNS advertisement confirmed live: GET /services returns _mavlink/_http records for eth0 (WIRED) advertised as blueos / blueos-ethernet. Raw evidence: /tmp/beacon_sample.json, /tmp/beacon_slo.json.

route_inventory.note: Routes confirmed on live Pi under /beacon/v1.0. GETs are read-only and were probed; the two POSTs mutate persisted identity and were not exercised.

running_baseline.note: GET contracts on a healthy running beacon (idle, no mutating actions).

GET /beacon/v1.0/services.body_predicate: array of mDNS records; eth0 WIRED advertises _mavlink._udp and _http._tcp as blueos / blueos-ethernet

slo_running_baseline.note: Latency percentiles over 40 repeats per route on the local network. /services is heaviest (enumerates advertised records across interfaces).

running_baseline.method: /proc stat deltas, top-style (100 == 1 core), PID 508 python3 beacon/main.py
running_baseline.note: beacon is near-idle: CPU spends most samples at 0 with periodic small spikes from the ~10s mDNS re-advertisement loop; RSS flat at ~40 MB.

navigator.notes: beacon advertises mDNS and serves identity regardless of flight controller; behavior is platform-independent on this Pi4/Navigator host.

state_machine: none (service_definition states: Unknown; beacon runs a periodic mDNS re-advertisement loop, not a discrete state machine)
settings_mutations: Not exercised. POST /vehicle_name and POST /hostname persist to /root/.config/beacon/settings-4.json (SettingsV4); not mutated during this read-only capture.
